assertion_review.fails_if_or_mutation: Put back the regression the comment names - a promotion that records a base other than the run's own - and the assertion reddens: recording the worktree head gives rev-parse(recorded) equal to the head rather than the fixture's base commit, and recording anything that does not resolve makes _git's check=True raise CalledProcessError, which errors the test. The expected side is derived by git from the fixture's seed commit rather than supplied by the promotion, so the two sides do not move together. Its narrow gap is that a symbolic value such as HEAD resolves to the base and would pass, so the guard's own claim (a revision a later reader can check) is a little wider than the assertion; the values promotion writes today are 40-character shas from the run record.
